findings.evidence: The only changed declaration is `@[expose] noncomputable def finiteModulesExactStructure`; `ExtEulerMatrix.lean:98` relies on identifying `ExactK0 (finiteModulesExactStructure A)` with the full-subcategory `ExactK0` expected by `extEulerPairing`, and its comment explicitly says this is definitional.
findings.fix: Keep the definition opaque and add an explicit API bridge (an equality/transport lemma or a finite-module specialization of `extEulerMatrix`) between `finiteModulesExactStructure A` and the induced full-subcategory structure.
findings.issue: `@[expose]` makes the implementation of the canonical finite-module exact structure public so the new matrix theorem can typecheck by unfolding it, coupling downstream users to its construction.

summary: The new matrix API is coherent, but it exposes an existing implementation body solely to bridge a definitional mismatch.
